Screen re-inclusion sensitivity (new, quantified, not measured): the frozen contamination screen removed 2 test-OOS and 4 test-app rows per G1 axis and 4 test-app rows on G3. Recomputing the frozen gates with those rows re-included would require scoring excluded TEST rows post hoc, which this audit deliberately did NOT do.
